svg.title: P1: operational ontology platform architecture
svg.desc: Twelve functional responsibilities connect source preparation, ontology model, graph builder, runtime, AI and controlled actions within a logical platform governance scope. P1 integrates the twelve common responsibilities within a logical platform governance scope. The illustration permits private and shared organizational scopes and configured external services; it does not impose a single-company or single-database limit. The Knowledge Graph Builder is an author-defined functional grouping that overlaps the Ontology Engine write path. Principal data, configuration, request and action paths are shown; Appendix A records the detailed flow groups. Author synthesis from the documented P1 baseline.
